newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested on a live basis, compared with Monday's close, USDA said. Trade slow. Demand and seller interest light. Offerings current and moderate.
